title: Cloning and Tracking a Shared Repository
description: Practice cloning and tracking a shared repository through a concrete team scenario.

blocks.content: You are joining an existing project. You need a local copy connected to the team repository before you can contribute. What is the smallest Git action that keeps the work safe?

Cloning copies a repository and sets up its default remote. `git clone URL` gives you a working directory plus its history.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["Working files"] -->|"choose an action"| B["Git history"] -->|"share or recover"| C["Team project"]
```

blocks.question: What does `git clone` create?
options: A local repository with project history
blocks.explanation: Cloning gives you files plus the repository history needed to work locally.

blocks.prompt: Model the Git idea in a tiny simulator. Export a function named `cloneFile` that takes `(working, staged, file)` and returns a new staged list containing `file` once. Do not change either input list.

tests.description: works when no working files are listed yet
keeps an already staged file while adding another
